full_details: At midday you boarded, the second threepence of the week. The hose from your mother were in the room. The four lines had gone with Hobbins. The long letter was still on the board. You did not start a speech from the shape of the king. At half past seven, in the lane off Bishopsgate, Morley had you in. The house is the one with the lit window of Twelfth Eve. His balletts are five voices, at the printer's this year. He would not name what the strings cost. A woman of the parish played a strain exact, and then the same strain faster. You knew the hand. You were not made known, you did not ask her name, and she did not speak. Nothing passed but the music. At home you said a few words about the jacks, wrote four lines with no name on them, and put a cross by the day.
one_sentence: You heard a strain played twice at Morley's, wrote four lines, and put a cross in the almanac.
title: A strain played twice, four lines, and a cross
